import pty, os, sys, time, select
pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.execvp('pmars', ['pmars', '-f', 'flashpaper.red', 'rave.red'])
out = b''
deadline = time.time() + 10
sent = 0
while time.time() < deadline:
    r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 1)
    if r:
        try:
            data = os.read(fd, 4096)
        except OSError:
            break
        if not data: break
        out += data
    if sent == 0 and b'\$' in out:
        os.write(fd, b'c\n')
        sent = 1
    elif sent == 1 and b'Continue' not in out and out.count(b'\$') >= 2:
        os.write(fd, b'q\n')
        sent = 2
os.waitpid(pid, 0)
print(out.decode(errors='replace')[-3000:])
